[attribute-contrib-id-type]
=== `@contrib-id-type` Contributor Identifier Type

Names the type of contributor identifier or the authority that is responsible for the creation of the contributor identifier.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-contrib-id,`<contrib-id>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type of contributor identifier or the authority (such as a publisher or
                        industry organization) that is responsible for the creation of the contributor identifier,
                        for
                        example, an 
                        ORCID (value “`orcid`”) or
                        a JST identifier (value “`jst`”).
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
